## Blocked audit: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22110 closed, so the card moves `pm:blocked` → `pm:on-hold`. The hold is now only the install face

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-09T10:05Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **What closed:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#22110 closed `completed` at 2026-10-09T09:41Z. PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22315 merged as `2b61f2d9d6`.
- **Why on hold, not unblocked:** this card's own unlock keys on the install face. The change is on the v18 line only:
  - npm `latest` is 17.7.0, and no 18.x is published;
  - `app-shell` pins `@objectstack/spec` `^17.6.0`.

  The console still talks to 17.x, where single-brace is accepted, so Studio's `{var}` help is not wrong yet. The precedent is objectui#11864.
- **Restart-when:** objectui's `@objectstack/spec` resolves a release that carries `2b61f2d9d6`.
- **The slots PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22315 converted** (its body and objectstack-ai/objectstack#22454's reading): the notify node's `title` / `message`, the screen node's `title` / `description`, and the end node's `message`. These are this card's "slots #22110 converts". Value slots are untouched, and ⛔ CEL roles keep their brace check.

## Carried here: a pending changeset that spec 18 makes false, for whoever lands this card's recipient-picker cutover · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z` · 2026-10-14T01:59Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ no label change.

- **Source:** contract review `6159189541` on objectui PR #12337 (objectui#12030, the move to `@objectstack/*` `18.0.0-next.0`), ③.
- **The sentence:** `.changeset/11788-notify-recipients-picker.md:8` says the recipient picker's `{record.FIELD}` recipients are "the values the messaging service already resolves". Under spec 18 that spelling is refused, and PR #12337's own pending pin says so.
- **Why it rides here:**
  - objectui#12030's PR kept the picker's `{…}` spellings at today's behaviour, pinned as PENDING for this card. That is the Studio flow-dialect cutover, ADR-0032 §3, which ruling `6148150305` Q3 routes here.
  - So whoever lands this card's cutover corrects that changeset sentence in the same PR, to what the picker writes after the cutover. A one-clause correction is enough, and the frontmatter stays unchanged.
- **Guard:** objectui#12334, the objectui 18.x release, carries the same sentence on its pre-release prose check. Nothing publishes before #12334 lands, so the sentence cannot ship false either way.

## Restart: `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue` · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`

The held condition is met. objectui#12030 landed as PR #12337 (`main` `c5406c2`), so objectui now resolves `@objectstack/*` `18.0.0-next.0`. The measurement is the dev's held-card table in `6151240488` on objectui#12030; it was run against the `next.0` tarball and the installed tree, with `17.7.0` as the negative control.
- **This card:** the Studio flow-dialect cutover (ADR-0032 §3). Ruling Q3 in `6148150305` on objectui#12030 routes it here, and it unlocks with this move.
- **Carried here as well:**
  - the recipient picker's `{…}` spellings and a blank Notify title, which objectui#12030 pinned as PENDING (the Notify title is filed separately as objectui#12343);
  - the stale sentence in `.changeset/11788-notify-recipients-picker.md:8` (`6159203238` above).

The card returns to `pm:queue` for its lane with its grade unchanged. ⛔ Not a claim. Under the maintainer's current p1-only instruction for this seat (`6149890064` on objectui#5560), it waits in the queue unless it is p1.

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12355 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-14T07:26Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `a847d3a65f`, against the card and ruling, not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft against `main`, and its body opens `Fixes #11824` (the only closing keyword). `Clause-②: no` matches the claim. The governed sweep (`check-governed-merges --pr objectstack-ai/objectui#12355`) reads NOT governed, 627 lines.
- **Scope is the five slots, as ruled.** `refMode: 'hole'` sits on exactly notify `title` / `message`, screen `title` / `description`, and end `message`. `mergeServerFlowFields` carries it onto a served field of the same key. The CEL predicate check is unchanged (`refMode === 'expression'` still gates the condition builder), and other text fields keep `template`.
- **Recipients (the dev disproved PM assumption A3).** Spec 18 refuses `{{ record.owner }}` in the `recipients` value slot too, so the picker writes the CEL envelope `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.FIELD' }` the spec prescribes. An edited row drops the envelope it was read from (`patchRow` sets `stored: undefined`). A stored `{record.FIELD}` string stays under Other unchanged. That follows ruling Q3's intent in the contract's spelling. Correction accepted: the PM's A3 was wrong.
- **Prose checked sentence by sentence:**
  - `.changeset/11788-notify-recipients-picker.md:8` now names the CEL envelope in place of `{record.FIELD}`, frontmatter unchanged, as carried by `6159203238`.
  - `.changeset/11824-flow-text-slots-double-brace.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell: minor`): every bullet matches the diff.
  - Its last line, "Nothing is added to the package entry", holds: app-shell's `exports` map is only `.` and `./styles.css`, and none of the touched modules is re-exported from `src/index.ts`.
  - The en and zh help strings changed are the five slots' and the end outcome's.
- **CI at head:** 29 success, 3 skipped, 1 failure. The failure is `Spec Main Shape Gate` (advisory), whose 21 annotations are on `resolveDataSource.ts` (6), `useViewData.ts` (4) and `.github` (11). That is the same signature as `main`'s run `38513810543`, so it is the base's red (objectui#12325, in flight), not this PR's.
- **Narrowed local run, declared:** the full app-shell type-check hit the verify-lock wait (exit 99 twice) and was narrowed to a `tsc -p` over the changed files. CI's `Type Check` is green on this head, which covers it.
- **Out-of-scope findings:** the dev's class b and c rows (Studio's notify Click-through URL, http URL and header cells, script `inputs` and screen `defaults` help still prescribe `{x}`, which spec 18 refuses) are one family: the rest of Studio's ADR-0032 flow-dialect cutover. Filed as one closure card; the link follows in this seat's next comment on this card. The verify-lock and `check:spec-floors` notes are not filed: `check:spec-floors` is carried by objectui#12334, and the lock note is a session observation.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
